nodes.description: Owned.owner : address of the current contract owner, set from msg.sender in the constructor and reassigned in acceptOwnership.
Owned.newOwner : pending owner address written by transferOwnership and consumed/reset by acceptOwnership.
XYOracleBonus.symbol public string token symbol.
XYOracleBonus.name public string token name.
XYOracleBonus.decimals public uint8 token decimals.
XYOracleBonus._totalSupply : total token supply assigned in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
XYOracleBonus.balances mapping(address=>uint) holding token balances, mutated by transfer/transferFrom.
XYOracleBonus.allowed mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) holding ERC20 allowances, mutated by approve/approveAndCall/transferFrom.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) pure returns (uint c) with overflow require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) pure returns (uint c) with underflow require(b <= a).
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) pure returns (uint c) with overflow require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) pure returns (uint c) with require(b > 0).
Owned() constructor : assigns owner = msg.sender.
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner) guarded by onlyOwner modifier, writes state_newOwner.
Owned.acceptOwnership() : requires msg.sender == newOwner then swaps owner and clears newOwner.
XYOracleBonus() constructor : initializes symbol/name/decimals/_totalSupply and mints the whole supply to a fixed address.
XYOracleBonus.totalSupply() view returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using unchecked subtraction.
XYOracleBonus.balanceOf(address tokenOwner) view returns balances[tokenOwner].
XYOracleBonus.transfer(address to, uint tokens) : moves tokens from msg.sender using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
XYOracleBonus.approve(address spender, uint tokens) : writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval without double-spend checks.
XYOracleBonus.transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) : moves tokens using allowance of msg.sender via safeSub/safeAdd.
XYOracleBonus.allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) view returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
XYOracleBonus.approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data) : sets allowance then performs an external call to spender.receiveApproval before returning.
XYOracleBonus fallback function () public payable that unconditionally reverts (rejects ETH).
XYOracleBonus.transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner : external call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens).
msg.sender : externally controlled caller address used for ownership, balance and allowance bookkeeping.

External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) with attacker-controlled spender contract; state (allowed) was written before the call, enabling reentrancy.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary caller-supplied contract address while inside an onlyOwner function.
Additive arithmetic c = a + b guarded by require(c >= a) inside safeAdd.
Subtractive arithmetic c = a - b guarded by require(b <= a) inside safeSub.
Multiplicative arithmetic c = a * b guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b) inside safeMul.
Division arithmetic c = a / b guarded by require(b > 0) inside safeDiv.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner state variable inside the Owned constructor.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender to state_owner before transferOwnership executes.
onlyOwner modifier gates the control flow of transferOwnership on the untrusted msg.sender.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal the pending newOwner before ownership is swapped.
The require(msg.sender == newOwner) check controls whether the ownership swap is executed.
transfer reads balances[msg.sender] to debit the caller.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller address.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller address.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the external callee.
Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership stores the caller-supplied _newOwner into state_newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
Constructor sets the symbol state variable.
Constructor sets the name state variable.
Constructor sets the decimals state variable.
Constructor sets _totalSupply to the fixed mint amount.
Constructor credits the entire supply into balances of the fixed deployer address.
totalSupply returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] with an unchecked arithmetic operation.
balanceOf returns the balances mapping entry for tokenOwner.
transfer updates balances of msg.sender and of the recipient.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit balances[to].
transfer calls safeSub to debit balances[msg.sender].
approve writes the allowance into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom updates balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom decrements the allowed[from][msg.sender] allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit balances[to].
transferFrom calls safeSub for balances[from] and the allowance.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before making the external call.
approveAndCall invokes the unsafe external receiveApproval call on the attacker-supplied spender contract.
transferAnyERC20Token uses owner as the recipient of the rescued tokens.
transferAnyERC20Token performs the external ERC20 transfer on the caller-supplied tokenAddress.
The external receiveApproval callee can call back into approveAndCall or transferFrom while the allowance write is already committed.
The arbitrary token contract invoked by transferAnyERC20Token can re-enter the owner-controlled contract.
